title: One AI Chat Can Cost 500 Milliliters of Water
hook: A long AI conversation can consume 500 milliliters of water.
closing: Digital answers still draw on physical water supplies shared by nearby communities.
question: Should apps show their water cost?

segments.say: Microsoft used 6.4 million cubic meters of water. Its data-center demand has more than tripled.
Google withdrew 21.2 million cubic meters. The AI race carries a water footprint measured far beyond household use.
One long AI conversation can cost 500 milliliters. Millions of chats turn a small bottle into a major demand.
